Title: Santa's Grotto at Ealing Broadway
ScheduleText: 14 November – 24 December 2026; book a time slot online (limited walk-ins on quiet weekdays). Quiet Grotto sessions for children with autism or additional needs
PriceText: £7.50 per child plus £1.50 booking fee per family
Description: Walk through a festive forest with elves and snowmen, then meet Santa in his cabin; every child on the good list gets a gift. Souvenir photos and keepsakes extra
NeedsInfo: Run by Great Grottos; daily times only in the booking system

Title: Half-term children's rides and carousel – Ealing Broadway Town Square
ScheduleText: October half-term, 24 October – 1 November 2026, in Town Square during shopping centre hours
Description: Fairground rides in Town Square, from a gentle ride for younger children to bigger rides for older ones
NeedsInfo: Ride prices and hours not listed. The centre puts rides on in school holidays; check its What's On page for Christmas

Title: Gemstones New Year show for 1–3 year olds: «Новогодняя ёлочка для Оленёнка» (in Russian)
Address: Little Ealing Primary School, Weymouth Avenue, Ealing
Description: A first New Year party for toddlers: games, dancing, songs and instruments with a little reindeer, then Ded Moroz and Snegurochka with presents and photos
NeedsInfo: Tickets limited (36 left on 28 Oct). Page also gives Hereford Road W5 5EA as the school address

Title: Gemstones New Year show for 4–10 year olds: «На планете роботов» (in Russian)
Address: Little Ealing Primary School, Weymouth Avenue, Ealing
ScheduleText: Sunday 13 December 2026, 15:30–17:00. Come in a robot costume for an extra present. Book tickets online
Description: "Planet of Robots" New Year show: characters, costumes, music, games, a robot costume contest, then Ded Moroz and Snegurochka with presents
NeedsInfo: Tickets limited (24 child tickets left on 28 Oct)
